# DoGood Agency

> DoGood Agency is a private coaching practice for founders before and after they sell their business. It works alongside their exit, succession and wealth advisors. It does not give financial, tax or legal advice.

DoGood works on the personal side of selling a business: who the founder is without the company, what comes next, and how to step into it. Founders work 1:1 with Seb Wichmann (founder) or one of a small team of Wayfinders. All work is private and remote, with optional in-person elements in the Founder Reclamation Partnership.

## Offers

- [Exit-Prep](https://www.dogoodagency.co/exit-prep): six weekly 1:1 sessions for founders who haven't sold yet. Fully remote. Ideally started 12 to 18 months before the sale.
- [The Founder Reclamation Partnership (FRP)](https://www.dogoodagency.co/the-reset): a private two-stage partnership for founders after the sale. Stage 1, The Reset, runs for 30 days. Stage 2, The Build, runs for 12 weeks and is by invitation only. Limited to 5 new founders a month.
- [ClarityValue Shift™](https://www.dogoodagency.co/clarityvalue-shift): the 4-step method inside Stage 1, The Reset: See, Interrupt, Choose, Reset.
- [NextLife Passage™](https://www.dogoodagency.co/nextlife-passage): the 4-step method inside Stage 2, The Build: Rework, Navigate, Realign, Integrate.
- [How it works](https://www.dogoodagency.co/pathway): which door fits: Exit-Prep before the sale, The Reset and The Build after it.
- [Apply for Stage 1](https://www.dogoodagency.co/apply-stage-1)

## For advisors

- [Advisor Center](https://www.dogoodagency.co/for-advisors): how DoGood works with exit planners, succession and wealth advisors, accountants and attorneys whose clients are selling, and how to refer a founder.
